Senses.Explanation: The first graph means “investigate, interrogate, or put to the test” (勘); the second means “break open or expose” (破). (勘破) is what a master does in a live encounter: he tests someone and sees through them. The stock capping declaration (勘破了也) ('[I have] seen him through') marks the testing as complete. The paradigm case is Zhaozhou, who hears of an old woman on the road to Mt. Wutai who answers every pilgrim's question with '(just) go straight on'; he goes up to test her (待我去勘過), comes back, and tells the monk (臺山婆子為汝勘破了也) ('I have seen the Mt. Wutai crone through for you'). Commentators then keep the word working by asking (什麼處是勘破處) ('and just where is the point where she got seen through?'). The verb is also turned reflexively: Dahui says to a monk (老僧被爾勘破) ('this old monk has been seen through by you') and, when the monk hesitates, hits him. In the (無門關) (the Gateless Barrier) the word both titles and closes cases: its case-table lists (趙州勘婆) ('Zhaozhou tests the crone'), the case itself ends (州歸謂眾曰)。(臺山婆子我與爾勘破了也), Wumen's comment turns the word into the probe (且道那裏是趙州勘破婆子處) ('say then: just where is the place Zhaozhou saw the crone through?'), and on the two-hermits case (州勘庵主) he writes (爭奈趙州却被二庵主勘破) ('but alas, Zhaozhou was himself seen through by the two hermits') — the tester can be out-tested. The probe form recurs in raised-case commentary: (老宿拈云)。(什麼處是勘破處) ('an old worthy took it up: where is the seeing-through point?'). The preliminary step has its own verb (勘過) ('go and test'): Zhaozhou announces (待我去勘過) ('wait till I go test her'), and Xuansha counters Xuefeng's praise of a student's verse (此子徹去也, 'this one has broken through') with (未可)。(此是意識著述)。(更須勘過始得) ('not yet — this is composition by the conceptual mind; he must still be tested').
Senses.Note: One corpus-wide sense; no master bends the word idiosyncratically. (勘破) is also used of 'seeing through' a case (公案) or checkpoint, but the defining Zen use is person-to-person testing. The Mt. Wutai crone case recurs verbatim across lamp records (燈錄), case-commentary, and recorded sayings (語錄), which is what makes the reading multi-source. Counts (462-text allowlist grep): (勘破) 1503 hits in 253 texts; the verdict formula (勘破了也) 241 in 118; the passive (被我勘破) 23 in 18; the commentators' probe (勘破處) 51 in 38 (什麼處是勘破處 7 hits in 7 texts, e.g. 老宿拈云。什麼處是勘破處 T47n1997 0804b28; 甚麼處是勘破處 2); the preliminary verb (勘過) 296 in 129 (待我去勘過 X80n1565 0092b11; 更須勘過始得 X80n1565 0152c22); the sibling term (勘辨) 171 in 77. (無門關) material: case-table (趙州勘婆) T48n2005 0292c06; (臺山婆子我與爾勘破了也) 0297a13; (且道那裏是趙州勘破婆子處) 0297a17; (爭奈趙州却被二庵主勘破) 0294b14.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師歸院謂僧曰。臺山婆子為汝勘破了也
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Section head is (趙州觀音院從諗禪師); (師) = Zhaozhou, returning to tell the monk he has seen the Mt. Wutai woman through. (Wudeng Huiyuan, a lamp record 燈錄.)

Occurrences.Kwic: 雪竇著語云。勘破了也。一似鐵橛相似。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Xuedou's capping phrase (著語) on the Deshan-visits-Guishan case; Yuanwu's commentary then asks (什麼處是勘破處) / (且道勘破德山勘破溈山). (Blue Cliff Record.)
Wansong's own capping ('萬松道。勘破了也') on the same Mt. Wutai woman case, adding the reflexive twist (亦乃累及萬松) ('it even implicates Wansong'). (Book of Serenity.)

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云。老僧被爾勘破。僧擬議。師便打。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: (師) = Dahui in his own recorded encounter; the inverted use — the master says HE has been seen through, then strikes. (Dahui's recorded sayings 語錄.)

Occurrences.Kwic: 州歸院云。婆子被我勘破了也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The line (婆子被我勘破了也) is Zhaozhou's (州), here raised and commented on ('趙州不施韜略...又却失利') in Xutang Zhiyu's yulu — an independent witness to the stock phrase.
